derivation: The retained history records two admitted renewals of the same permitted occurrence, and both new permits name the same prior permit as superseded. Each renewal carries its own proposal record, receipt, replay and transaction commitment, all consistent, so the only defect is the chain itself: LIFE-019 requires one finite linear permit chain per occurrence in which every permit has at most one immediate successor and exactly one unsuperseded head exists while the occurrence is PERMITTED, and names a fork or several heads STATE_INVALID. Restart returns STATE_INVALID before applying the event.
